name: Jammu and Kashmīr
summary_text: No region-specific trans law or enforcement series was located in the research pass; the unit's distinction is structural rather than legislative. In 2019 the former state was reconstituted as a union territory governed by an appointed Administrator without a legislature, and armed-forces jurisdiction under AFSPA persists in parts — a heavy checkpoint-and-document regime that raises appearance-and-identity scrutiny for every traveller, and therefore specifically for anyone whose documents and presentation differ.

sources.title: Transgender Bill: India parliament passes amendment to redefine transgender identity amid protests
sources.claim_summary: BBC report (26 March 2026): India's parliament passed the amendment removing self-identification from transgender legal recognition (medical-board certification, narrowed definition, protests, Supreme Court panel objection). Nationally applicable framework that also governs this union territory.

Times of India city report (18 August 2024): a 'gender check' groping allegation against a railway-police constable at a Kolkata metro station, denied by police with a counter-FIR — national evidence of checkpoint 'gender verification' practice, directly relevant in a territory defined by its security checkpoints, though no trans-specific J&K case was found.
